points.title: 贵族少年
points.description: 1815年4月1日，俾斯麦出生于普鲁士申豪森的一个容克贵族家庭。他的童年和青少年时期在申豪森度过，接受了典型的贵族教育。这段时期塑造了他后来保守的政治立场和对普鲁士王室的忠诚。他在格赖夫斯瓦尔德大学和柏林大学学习法律，但学业并不突出，反而以决斗和饮酒闻名。这段经历培养了他坚韧不拔的性格和对权力的渴望，为他日后在政治舞台上的表现奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Born on April 1, 1815, in Schönhausen, Prussia, Bismarck came from a Junker aristocratic family. His childhood and youth in Schönhausen shaped his later conservative political stance and loyalty to the Prussian monarchy. He studied law at the universities of Greifswald and Berlin, but his academic performance was unremarkable; instead, he became known for dueling and drinking. This period fostered his resilient character and hunger for power, laying the foundation for his later political career.

points.title: 政治崛起
points.description: 1847年，俾斯麦当选为普鲁士邦议会成员，正式步入政坛。他以其保守立场和雄辩的口才迅速崭露头角。1848年欧洲革命期间，他坚决反对自由主义改革，主张维护君主专制。1851年，他被任命为普鲁士驻法兰克福邦联议会代表，这一职位使他有机会深入了解德意志各邦的政治状况，并形成了他后来统一德意志的战略思想。在柏林的这段经历，使他从地方贵族转变为具有全国视野的政治家。
points.descriptionEn: In 1847, Bismarck was elected to the Prussian Landtag, officially entering politics. He quickly stood out with his conservative stance and eloquent oratory. During the 1848 European revolutions, he firmly opposed liberal reforms, advocating for monarchical absolutism. In 1851, he was appointed Prussian representative to the Frankfurt Bundestag, where he gained deep insights into the political landscape of German states and developed his strategy for German unification. This period in Berlin transformed him from a local noble into a politician with national vision.

points.title: 铁血宰相
points.description: 1862年，俾斯麦被任命为普鲁士首相，开始了他政治生涯中最辉煌的时期。他发表了著名的'铁血演说'，宣称德意志的统一不能依靠'议会和多数票，而必须依靠铁和血'。他通过三次王朝战争（1864年普丹战争、1866年普奥战争、1870-1871年普法战争）实现了德意志的统一。1867年，他成为北德意志邦联首相，1871年德意志帝国成立后，他出任帝国首任宰相，并担任这一职位近20年。在柏林的这段时间，他通过'现实主义外交'和'大陆政策'，使德国成为欧洲大陆的霸主。
points.descriptionEn: In 1862, Bismarck was appointed Prime Minister of Prussia, beginning the most brilliant period of his political career. He delivered his famous 'Iron and Blood' speech, declaring that German unification could not be achieved by 'parliament and majority votes, but by iron and blood.' Through three dynastic wars—the Danish War (1864), Austro-Prussian War (1866), and Franco-Prussian War (1870-1871)—he achieved German unification. In 1867, he became Chancellor of the North German Confederation, and after the German Empire was founded in 1871, he served as its first Chancellor for nearly 20 years. During this time in Berlin, he made Germany a dominant power in Europe through 'realpolitik' and the 'Continental Policy.'

points.title: 帝国治理
points.description: 作为德意志帝国首任宰相，俾斯麦在柏林建立了复杂的政治体系，通过'卡普里维政策'平衡各方利益。他创建了世界上第一个现代福利国家，引入了健康保险、事故保险和养老金制度，这些政策对后世产生了深远影响。在外交方面，他构建了复杂的联盟体系，维持了欧洲的相对和平。然而，随着威廉二世1888年即位，君臣之间在政策上的分歧日益加深。1890年，俾斯麦被威廉二世解职，结束了他在柏林的政治生涯。尽管如此，他在柏林制定的许多政策仍然影响着德国的发展方向。
points.descriptionEn: As the first Chancellor of the German Empire, Bismarck established a complex political system in Berlin, balancing various interests through the 'Caprivi Policy.' He created the world's first modern welfare state, introducing health insurance, accident insurance, and pension systems that had far-reaching impacts. In foreign affairs, he constructed a complex alliance system that maintained relative peace in Europe. However, as Wilhelm II ascended the throne in 1888, disagreements between the monarch and the chancellor deepened. In 1890, Bismarck was dismissed by Wilhelm II, ending his political career in Berlin. Nevertheless, many of the policies he formulated continued to influence Germany's development.

points.title: 晚年岁月
points.description: 被解职后，俾斯麦回到他在汉堡附近的弗里德里希斯鲁庄园度过了晚年。虽然离开了政治舞台，但他仍然密切关注政治发展，经常发表文章和演讲批评威廉二世的政策。他撰写了回忆录《思考与回忆》，详细记录了他的政治生涯和思想。1898年7月30日，俾斯麦在弗里德里希斯鲁去世，享年83岁。他的葬礼成为一场全国性的哀悼活动，象征着他在德国人民心中的崇高地位。弗里德里希斯鲁的岁月见证了这位'铁血宰相'从权力中心到历史人物的转变，他的思想和政策遗产继续影响着德国乃至欧洲的历史进程。
points.descriptionEn: After his dismissal, Bismarck retired to his estate at Friedrichsruh near Hamburg, where he spent his later years. Although away from the political center, he closely followed political developments and frequently published articles and speeches criticizing Wilhelm II's policies. He wrote his memoirs 'Thoughts and Recollections,' documenting his political career and thoughts. On July 30, 1898, Bismarck died at Friedrichsruh at the age of 83. His funeral became a national mourning event, symbolizing his esteemed position in the hearts of the German people. The years at Friedrichsruh witnessed the transformation of the 'Iron Chancellor' from a man of power to a historical figure, and his ideological and policy legacy continued to influence German and European history.

supporter.zh: 俾斯麦被支持者视为德国统一的伟大缔造者和国家统一的象征。他通过外交手腕和军事策略，成功将分散的德意志邦国整合成一个强大的民族国家。他建立的福利制度开创了现代社会保障的先河，为德国工人阶级提供了基本保障，稳定了社会秩序。他的现实主义外交政策使德国在复杂的欧洲政治格局中获得了应有的地位，避免了德国陷入不必要的战争。俾斯麦的政治智慧和战略眼光被视为德国政治传统的典范。
supporter.en: Supporters view Bismarck as the great architect of German unification and a symbol of national unity. Through diplomatic skill and military strategy, he successfully integrated the scattered German states into a powerful nation. The welfare system he established pioneered modern social security, providing basic protection for the German working class and stabilizing social order. His realpolitik foreign policy secured Germany's rightful position in the complex European political landscape, avoiding unnecessary conflicts. Bismarck's political wisdom and strategic vision are regarded as paragons of German political tradition.

critic.zh: 批评者认为俾斯麦的统一是通过'铁与血'的暴力手段实现的，忽视了民主进程和人民意愿。他的保守主义政策压制了自由主义发展，强化了军国主义传统，为后来的德国军国主义埋下伏笔。他建立的威权政治体系限制了公民权利，中央集权的官僚体制扼杀了地方自治精神。此外，俾斯麦的对外政策虽然短期内成功，但长期来看加剧了欧洲的紧张局势，为第一次世界大战的爆发创造了条件。他的民族主义思想也被批评为排外和狭隘。
critic.en: Critics argue that Bismarck's unification was achieved through violent 'iron and blood' methods, neglecting democratic processes and popular will. His conservative policies suppressed liberal development, reinforced militarist traditions, and laid the groundwork for later German militarism. The authoritarian political system he established limited civil rights, and the centralized bureaucratic system stifled local autonomy. Furthermore, while his foreign policy was successful in the short term, it intensified European tensions in the long run, creating conditions for the outbreak of World War I. His nationalist ideology is also criticized as exclusionary and narrow-minded.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，俾斯麦被视为一位复杂而矛盾的历史人物。他既是现代德国的奠基人，也是欧洲权力政治的典型代表。他的'现实主义外交'理念成为国际关系研究的重要概念，而他的福利政策则被视为现代国家职能的先驱。在流行文化中，俾斯麦常被描绘为'铁血宰相'的形象，象征着德国的崛起与矛盾。历史学家普遍认为，俾斯麦的遗产是双重的：他创造了统一的德国，但也建立了威权传统；他推动了社会进步，但也强化了军国主义。这种复杂性使他成为理解19世纪欧洲政治的关键人物。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Bismarck is viewed as a complex and contradictory figure. He is both the founder of modern Germany and a quintessential representative of European power politics. His concept of 'realpolitik' has become an important term in international relations studies, while his welfare policies are seen as precursors to modern state functions. In popular culture, Bismarck is often depicted as the 'Iron Chancellor,' symbolizing Germany's rise and contradictions. Historians generally agree that Bismarck's legacy is dual: he created a unified Germany but also established authoritarian traditions; he promoted social progress but also reinforced militarism. This complexity makes him a key figure for understanding 19th-century European politics.

self.zh: 德意志的统一不能依靠议会和多数票，而必须依靠铁和血。
self.en: The great questions of the day will not be settled by means of speeches and majority decisions—that was the mistake of 1848 and 1849—but by iron and blood.

others.zh: 俾斯麦是欧洲历史上最伟大的政治家之一，他不仅改变了德国的命运，也重塑了欧洲的政治格局。
others.en: Bismarck was one of the greatest statesmen in European history; he not only changed the destiny of Germany but also reshaped the political landscape of Europe.
